23174-a-good-for-nothing-1876.description: A book by Hjalmar Hjorth Boyesen. As Ralph grew up from infancy to childhood, he began to give decided promise of future distinction. He was fond of sitting down in a corner and sucking his thumb, which his mother interpreted as the sign of that brooding disposition peculiar to poets and men of lofty genius. At the age of five, he had become sole master in the house.

8409-love-letters-between-a-nobleman-and.description: A book by Aphra Behn. 's heart, which the illustrious _Cesario_ had before possessed; however, consulting her honour and her interest, and knowing all the arts as women do to feign a tenderness; she yields to marry him: while _Philander_, who scorned to owe his happiness to the commands of parents, or to chaffer for a beauty, with her consent steals her away, and marries her.

arxiv-2005-09077.title: Broad-band X-ray observation of broad-line radio galaxy 3C 109 Journal: ApJ Facilities: NuSTAR , XMM , Swift
arxiv-2005-09077.creator: Sulov Chalise, Anne M. Lohfink, Erin Kara, Andrew C. Fabian
arxiv-2005-09077.description: Abstract We present a study of the central engine in the broad-line radio galaxy 3C 109. To investigate the immediate surrounding of this accreting, supermassive black hole, we perform a multi-epoch broad-band spectral analysis of a joint NuSTAR / XMM observation (2017), an archival XMM observation (2005) and the 105-month averaged Swift -BAT data.

arxiv-2202-14038.title: The Three Hundred project: The Gizmo-Simba run 2022 The Three Hundred project: The Gizmo-Simba run – C
arxiv-2202-14038.creator: Weiguang Cui, Romeel Dave, Alexander Knebe, Elena Rasia, Meghan Gray, Frazer Pearce, Chris Power, Gustavo Yepes, Dhayaa Anbajagane, Daniel Ceverino, Ana Contreras-Santos, Daniel de Andres, Marco De Petris, Stefano Ettori, Roan Haggar, Qingyang Li Yang Wang, Xiaohu Yang, Stefano Borgani, Klaus Dolag,
arxiv-2202-14038.description: Abstract We introduce Gizmo-Simba , a new suite of galaxy cluster simulations within The Three Hundred project. The Three Hundred consists of zoom re-simulations of 324 clusters with M 200 ≳ 10 14.8 ​ M ⊙ M_{200}\gtrsim 10^{14.8}M_{\odot} drawn from the MultiDark-Planck N N -body simulation, run using several hydrodynamic and semi-analytic codes.

arxiv-2210-16154.title: Chirality-induced intrinsic charge rectification in a tellurium-based field-effect transistor
arxiv-2210-16154.creator: Daichi Hirobe, Yoji Nabei, Hiroshi M. Yamamoto
arxiv-2210-16154.description: Abstract We report gate-induced enhancement of intrinsic charge rectification without p-n junctions in chiral semiconductor Te under magnetic field B B . As gating shifts the chemical potential to the valence band maximum of Te, the charge rectification efficiency is enhanced hundredfold.

arxiv-2305-17279.title: Archetypal solution spaces for clustering gene expression datasets in identification of cancer subtypes
arxiv-2305-17279.creator: Y. Wu, L. Dicks, D. J. Wales
arxiv-2305-17279.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Y. Wu, L. Dicks, D. J. Wales. Gene expression profiles are essential in identifying different cancer phenotypes. Clustering gene expression datasets can provide accurate identification of cancerous cell lines, but this task is challenging due to the small sample size and high dimensionality. Using the K K -means clustering algorithm we determine the organisation of the solution space for a variety of gene expression datasets using energy landscape theory.

arxiv-2306-02111.title: Simulating Noisy Quantum Circuits for Cryptographic Algorithms
arxiv-2306-02111.creator: Sahay Harshvardhan, Sanil Jain, James E. McClure, Caleb McIrvin, Ngoc Quy Tran
arxiv-2306-02111.description: Abstract The emergence of noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) computers has important consequences for cryptographic algorithms. It is theoretically well-established that key algorithms used in cybersecurity are vulnerable to quantum computers due to the fact that theoretical security guarantees, designed based on algorithmic complexity for classical computers, are not sufficient for quantum circuits.

arxiv-2409-08070.title: All-optical Fourier neural network using partially coherent light
arxiv-2409-08070.creator: Jianwei Qin, Yanbing Liu, Yan Liu, Xun Liu, Wei Li, Fangwei Ye
arxiv-2409-08070.description: Abstract Optical neural networks present distinct advantages over traditional electrical counterparts, such as accelerated data processing and reduced energy consumption. While coherent light is conventionally employed in optical neural networks, our study proposes harnessing spatially incoherent light in all-optical Fourier neural networks.

arxiv-2506-12602.title: Exploring the link between FRBs and binary neutron stars Origins with Space-borne Gravitational Wave Observations
arxiv-2506-12602.creator: Yu-xuan Yin(尹宇轩), En-kun Li(李恩坤), Bing Zhang(张冰), Yi-Ming Hu(胡一鸣)
arxiv-2506-12602.description: Abstract The origin of repeating Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) is an open question, with observations suggesting that at least some are associated with old stellar populations. It has been proposed that some repeating FRBs may be produced by interactions of the binary neutron star magnetospheres decades to centuries before the coalescence.

arxiv-2510-19299.title: Learning to Make Friends: Coaching LLM Agents toward Emergent Social Ties
arxiv-2510-19299.creator: Philipp J. Schneider, Lin Tian, Marian-Andrei Rizoiu
arxiv-2510-19299.description: Abstract Can large language model (LLM) agents reproduce the complex social dynamics that characterize human online behavior—shaped by homophily, reciprocity, and social validation—and what memory and learning mechanisms enable such dynamics to emerge? We present a multi-agent LLM simulation framework in which agents repeatedly interact, evaluate one another, and adapt their behavior through in-context learning accelerated by a coaching signal.

pmc-11353475.title: Feedback Approach for the Relay Channel with Noisy Feedback and Its Security Analysis
pmc-11353475.creator: Rong Hu, Haonan Zhang, Huan Yang, Predrag Ivanis, Goran Djordjević
pmc-11353475.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Relay channels capture the essence of several important communication scenarios such as sensor network and satellite communication. In this paper, first, we propose an efficient coding scheme for an additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) relay channel in the presence of AWGN feedback, which generalizes the conventional scheme for the AWGN relay channel with noiseless feedback by introducing a lattice-based strategy to eliminate the impact of the feedback channel noise on the performance of the original scheme.

pmc-11603789.creator: Tingting Han, Tianyu Liang, Renyang Liu, Yinyin Quan
pmc-11603789.description: BackgroundPrevious studies on the relationship between interleukin-8 (IL-8) rs4073 polymorphism and sepsis susceptibility have covered contradictory results. The aim of this study is to investigate the function and working mechanism of LINC02159 in TNBC.

pmc-13566220.title: The Impact of Chronic Severe Preoperative Local Infection on Postoperative Complications and Recurrence Following Winograd Procedure for Ingrown Toenail of the Great Toes: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13566220.creator: Ji Yong Yun, Jin Soo Suh, Yun Beom Lee, Jun Young Choi
pmc-13566220.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: The Winograd procedure is a widely utilized surgical option for treating ingrown toenails. However, there is a lack of comparative data regarding its outcomes in the presence of active infection. The objective of this study was to compare the clinical outcomes and complication rates of the Winograd procedure for great toe ingrown toenails between patients with and without chronic severe preoperative local infection.

pmc-13680593.title: Increase in 6-pentyl-alpha-pyrone production by Trichoderma spp. in liquid medium using in situ removal by adsorbent resin

pmc-13680593.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The Trichoderma-produced secondary metabolite 6-pentyl-alpha-pyrone (6-PP) has demonstrated promise for agricultural applications, but cost-effective bioproduction remains limited by product inhibition during fermentation. This study aimed to evaluate the effect of media type on 6-PP production in T. atroviride IMI206040, screen production by nine New Zealand Trichoderma strains, and assess Amberlite XAD-4 in situ product removal in five strains to overcome self-inhibition.
